title: Practice 10: за and под: going behind, under

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Я за ___ (реформа, acc. sg.) немецкого правописания.
exercises.prompt: I am in favor of a German orthographic reform.
exercises.why: **реформа → реформу** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's газета — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  Declension: sg. реформа · реформы · реформе · реформу · реформой · реформе; pl. реформы · реформ · реформам · реформы · реформами · реформах.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Гордость зашибла: не буду, мол, подлаживаться под ___ (грязная гимнастёрка, acc. pl.).
exercises.why: **гимнастёрка → гимнастерки** (acc. pl.). Feminine, inanimate; nominative plural гимнастёрки. Declines like DLI's газета — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. газеты). Ending -а → -и.  **грязный → грязные** (acc. pl., agreeing with гимнастерки). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. гимнастёрка · гимнастёрки · гимнастёрке · гимнастёрку · гимнастёркой · гимнастёрке; pl. гимнастёрки · гимнастёрок · гимнастёркам · гимнастёрки · гимнастёрками · гимнастёрках.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  «The letter ы never follows г, к, х, ж, ч, ш, щ; therefore: книга — книги, река — реки, госпожа — госпожи.» — DLI, Lesson 23.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the adjectives of the "soft", "guttural" and "sibilant" types are declined in the plural in the very same way.» — DLI, Lesson 48.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Солдат получил орден за ___ (свой подвиг, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: The soldier was decorated for his brave deed.
exercises.why: **подвиг → подвиг** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **свой → свой** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with подвиг). A possessive — declines like DLI's мой. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. подвиг · подвига · подвигу · подвиг · подвигом · подвиге; pl. подвиги · подвигов · подвигам · подвиги · подвигами · подвигах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «Notice the similarity of the endings of the possessives to the form of «они».» мой · моё — моего — моему — моим — о моём; моя — моей — мою; мои — моих — моим — моими — о моих. — DLI, Lessons 47–48.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

**ночь → ночь** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -ь. Declines like DLI's часть — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. часть). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **один → одну** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with ночь). «один» is a pronoun-type word with its own declension, not the regular adjective pattern, so no ending rule is claimed. Its forms (f. sg.): одна · одной · одной · одну · одной · одной.
